duomo.name: Duomo di Milano
duomo.price_text: Cathedral entry from about €10 · rooftop terraces extra (check on the day)
duomo.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–19:00 · last entry earlier (check on the day)
duomo.tip: Book a rooftop ticket online and go early to skip the long queue at the door.
duomo.best: Early morning for fewer crowds; clear day for the terraces

lastsupper.name: The Last Supper
lastsupper.price_text: About €15 plus booking fee (check on the day)
lastsupper.hours: Tue–Sun, timed slots only · closed Monday
lastsupper.tip: Tickets sell out weeks ahead. Book online the moment your dates are fixed.
lastsupper.best: Any slot; book far in advance

galleria.name: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
galleria.tip: Look up at the glass roof and mosaics. Spin on the bull mosaic for luck, like locals do.
galleria.best: Morning or evening for fewer crowds

sforza.name: Sforza Castle
sforza.price_text: Courtyards free · some museums charge (check on the day)
sforza.hours: Courtyards daily roughly 07:00–19:30 · museums closed Monday
sforza.tip: Walk the free courtyards, then exit the back gate into Parco Sempione for a green break.

piazzaduomo.name: Piazza del Duomo
piazzaduomo.tip: The square is the city's living room. Watch for pickpockets in the crowds and ignore men offering 'free' bracelets.
piazzaduomo.best: Early morning or after dark when the cathedral is lit

bocconi.name: Bocconi University
bocconi.price_text: Free to walk the campus grounds
bocconi.hours: Campus open on weekdays · buildings for students and staff
bocconi.tip: Only worth a detour if you have a campus visit planned. Otherwise skip it.

certosa.name: Certosa di Pavia
certosa.price_text: Church free · some areas charge (check on the day)
certosa.hours: Daily, roughly morning to late afternoon with a midday break (check on the day)
certosa.tip: It is outside Milan, about 30–40 minutes by train. Check train times and opening hours before you go.

idroscalo.name: Europark Idroscalo Milano
idroscalo.price_text: Park free · some activities charge (check on the day)
idroscalo.hours: Park daily · activity hours vary by season
idroscalo.tip: A lake park east of the centre for walking and watersports. Bring sun protection; shade is limited.

greenland.name: Greenland
greenland.tip: Confirm what is open before travelling out. It is a local leisure park, not a headline sight.

minigolf.name: Minigolf Adventure
minigolf.tip: A family stop, not a must-see. Call ahead for opening times and prices.

politecnico.name: Politecnico di Milano
politecnico.price_text: Free to walk the campus grounds
politecnico.tip: Visit only for a campus tour or event. The historic Città Studi buildings are the draw.

prehistoric.name: Prehistoric Park
prehistoric.tip: A small family park with dinosaur models. Confirm opening days before you go.

sansiro.name: San Siro
sansiro.price_text: Stadium museum and tour from about €20 (check on the day)
sansiro.hours: Tour times vary on match days (check on the day)
sansiro.tip: Check the fixture list first. Match days change everything and tours may stop.

santamaria.name: Santa Maria delle Grazie
santamaria.price_text: Church free · Last Supper ticket separate
santamaria.hours: Church daily with a midday break (check on the day)
santamaria.tip: The church is free and quiet. Combine it with your Last Supper slot next door.
santamaria.best: Morning, before or after the Last Supper

starbucks.name: Starbucks Reserve Roastery Milan
starbucks.tip: A grand former post office with copper roasters. Go off-peak; it gets very busy.

scala.name: Teatro alla Scala
scala.price_text: Museum from about €15 · opera tickets vary widely (check on the day)
scala.tip: Book opera tickets early. The museum is a cheap way to see the theatre if you miss a show.
scala.best: Evening for a performance; daytime for the museum

navigli.name: Navigli canal walk
navigli.price_text: Free to walk · aperitivo from about €10–15
navigli.hours: Canals always open · bars busiest from 18:00
navigli.tip: Walk the Naviglio Grande at sunset, then stop for aperitivo. Book dinner spots on weekends.
navigli.best: Sunset into evening; spring and summer

brera.name: Brera district walk
brera.hours: Always open · shops and cafés daytime to evening
brera.tip: Wander the narrow lanes, then sit in the Pinacoteca courtyard. Quietest in the morning.

portanuova.name: Porta Nuova and Bosco Verticale viewpoint
portanuova.hours: Always open · best lit after dark
portanuova.tip: See the green towers from Piazza Gae Aulenti. Go after dark for the lights.

market.name: Mercato Comunale (food market)
market.price_text: Free to browse · food priced per item
market.hours: Mornings, closed Sunday (check on the day)
market.tip: Go before noon for the freshest stalls. Bring cash for small vendors.

tram.name: Historic tram ride (line 1)
tram.price_text: Standard city ticket, about €2 (check on the day)
tram.hours: Runs daily from early to late
tram.tip: A cheap way to see the centre. Validate your ticket before boarding.

walkingtour.name: Centre walking tour
walkingtour.price_text: About €25–40 for a small-group tour (check on the day)
walkingtour.tip: A guided walk links the Duomo, Galleria and castle in one go. Book ahead in summer.
